card.name: Digits inside round numbers like 30, 100, 200
card.fires_on: A digit inside a multi-digit number, mostly a 0 or a leading digit after 'top' or in epinephrine ratios such as 1:100,000. It fires where a round number is still being written out.

modes.label: Epinephrine ratios
modes.description: The digit inside the denominator of an epinephrine dilution paired with lidocaine, such as 1:100,000 or 1:200,000.

modes.label: Top-N lists
modes.description: A digit in a number after 'top' in web page titles and key-phrase counts.

card.writes: It promotes other digits and suppresses time units like minutes, so it pushes the model to keep writing digits rather than a unit.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a round number, such as the zeros in 1:100,000, where more digits are still to come.
